task: modify the seat booking functionality to introduce new booking rules
goal: Show the main components that own seat booking, their responsibilities, how they interact, and which parts a booking-rules change may affect.
source_goal: I am a software developer. I need to modify the seat booking functionality to introduce new booking rules. Before changing the code, I need to understand the main components involved in this functionality, their responsibilities, and how they interact with each other. I also want to identify which parts of the system may be affected by the modification.
